<div class="card-body">
'''Escape Pod''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">脱出ポッド</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">大型艦がロストした際に使う。大型艦に乗っていた全キャラクター、武器、デバイスは、ロストしない。それらは、好きな惑星上の位置か自分の大型艦に、置きなおす。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-79o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">大型艦には、緊急脱出ポッドが搭載されている。水、食料、照明弾、医療品、狩猟用ブラスター、救助ビーコンを装備。Ｒ２－Ｄ２は、脱出の際、ビーコンを止めた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Escape Pod.

'''Card text:''' Use when a capital starship is lost. All characters, weapons, and devices that were aboard are not lost. Relocate them to any planet site or to one of your capital starships.

'''Lore:''' Capital starships carry emergency escape pods, stocked with water, food, flares, medical supplies, a hunting blaster, and a rescue beacon. R2-D2 shut the beacon off during the escape.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese relocates them to a planet site or your capital starship; the English relocates them to any planet site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Escape Pod]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
